samples.question: All four mosaics are woven into one uninterrupted navy atlas; any background-colored hole makes it unreadable. In the gold-framed 5-by-5 source, count cyan tiles in each whole row and each whole column. A result tile is cyan exactly when both its source row and its source column contain an odd number of cyan tiles; otherwise it is cream. Keep every row and column position. Which red, green, or blue tag marks the exact 5-by-5 result?
